lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bağlayıcı anlaşma çekirdeğini ad, karşılıklı sözleşme ve antla pekiştirilmiş söz verme biçimlerinde ayırır; bunları sıradan söz vermeye genellemez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; korunan söz, genel yükümlülük kurma, karşılıklı söz verme, güvence bağı ve aynı kökün somut bağlama kolu en açıklayıcı karşılaştırmaları sağladı. Diğerleri daha uzak işlem türleri veya bu sınırların yinelemeleridir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kolunda anlaşmanın sağlamlaştırılması, karşılıklı kurulması ve antla pekiştirilmesi öne çıkar. Komşu kol ise anlaşmanın yanında koruma ve dokunulmazlık durumlarını, bunlara bağlı kişileri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Karşılıklı sözleşme yapma ve belirli bir işi antla üstlenme eylemlerini açıkça içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Koruma, dokunulmazlık, güvence ilişkisi ve bu ilişkiye bağlı kişi veya topluluk durumlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da tarafları bağlayan, tutulması beklenen güçlü bir anlaşma veya sözü anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kolunun ayırıcı yönü anlaşmanın güçlü bir söz veya antla güvenceye alınmasıdır. Komşu kol ise yükümlülük kuran işlemleri daha geniş biçimde kapsar; bu tür pekiştirme her zaman gerekli değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Anlaşmanın güçlü bir söz veya antla pekiştirilmiş ve güvenceye alınmış olmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Alım satım, evlenme ve her türlü hukuki yükümlülük kurma gibi daha geniş işlem türlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da tarafları bağlayan ve onlara uyma yükümlülüğü getiren anlaşmalar alanında örtüşür.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kolu ortaya çıkan güçlü ve bağlayıcı anlaşmayı merkez alır. Komşu kol ise yalnız iki taraflı söz verme olayını merkez alır; sözlerin ayrıca güvenceye bağlanması zorunlu değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kurulan anlaşmanın bağlayıcı ve güçlü biçimde güvenceye alınmış olmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: bağlayıcı anlaşma ile karşılıklı söz verme
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İki tarafın birbirine söz vermesi eylemini anlatır; sözlerin bağlayıcı bir anlaşmaya dönüşmesi gerekmez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Karşılıklı söz verme, taraflar arasında bağlayıcı bir anlaşma kurulmasının bir yolu olabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kolunda güçlü sözleşme ve yükümlülük çekirdektir. Komşu kol anlaşmanın yanında koruma, güvenlik ve genel bağlantı araçlarını da kapsar; bu yüzden anlam alanı daha geniştir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Pekiştirilmiş söz veya anlaşmanın tarafları yükümlü kılan yönünü öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Koruma, güvenlik, komşuluk ve kişiler ya da şeyler arasında bağlantı kurma gibi daha geniş ilişkileri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Güvence ve korunma sağlayan bir anlaşma, iki kolun ortak kullanım alanını oluşturabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kolundaki bağ, kişilerin uyması gereken söz ve anlaşma üzerinden kurulur. Komşu koldaki bağ ise somut bir araçla fiziksel olarak kurulur; aralarında olağan anlam ikamesi yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişileri verdikleri söze bağlayan soyut ve toplumsal bir yükümlülük kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Canlı veya nesneyi iple ya da başka bir araçla somut olarak bağlayıp hareketini sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir şeyi serbest bırakmayan, onu belirli bir durumda tutan bağ düşüncesiyle ilişkilidir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الميثاق: العهد المحكم (maqayis)؛ الميثاق من المواثقة والمعاهدة ومنه الموثق؛ واثقته بالله لأفعلن (ayn;tahdhib)؛ الميثاق: العهد؛ والجمع مواثيق (jamhara)؛ الميثاق: العهد؛ الموثق: الميثاق؛ المواثقة: المعاهدة (sihah)؛ الميثاق: عقد مؤكد بيمين وعهد؛ والموثق الاسم منه (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, tutulması güvenceye bağlanmış güçlü söz veya anlaşma çekirdeğinde birleşir. Karşılıklı sözleşme, ant içerek belirli bir işi yapmayı üstlenme ve böyle bir güvenceyi karşı taraftan alma bu çekirdeğin başlıca gerçekleşmeleridir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الميثاق والموثق والمواثقة والمعاهدة، والعهد المحكم أو العقد المؤكد بيمين وعهد.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد الوثاق الحسي، ولا وصف الشخص بأنه ثقة، ولا إحكام الشيء إلا إذا صار عهدا موثقا.

root_profile.summary: Kök, bir kişi ya da şeye güvenip dayanma, bir şeyi sağlamlaştırma veya sağlam bulma, sıkıca bağlama ve bağ aracını adlandırma, son olarak bağlayıcı ve pekiştirilmiş anlaşma kurma çevresinde dört kola ayrılır. Bu kollar, dayanılır ve çözülmez durumda olma düşüncesiyle ilişkili kalırken ayrı çekirdeklere sahiptir.

text.arabic_uthmani: لَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَٰقَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ رُسُلًۭا ۖ كُلَّمَا جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۢ بِمَا لَا تَهْوَىٰٓ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَرِيقًۭا كَذَّبُوا۟ وَفَرِيقًۭا يَقْتُلُونَ

baseline.text: İsrailoğullarından kesin söz aldık ve onlara elçiler gönderdik. Ne zaman canlarının istemediği bir şeyle bir elçi gelse bir kısmını yalanladılar, bir kısmını da öldürüyorlardı.

findings.text: İç eğilim, ardışık elçileri kabul kapısında ayırarak bir kısmını yalanlama, bir kısmını öldürme sonucuna götürür.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and holding supplies the secured side of the covenant mechanism.
Binding and tethering make the covenant an operative restraint rather than a background promise.
Sending and release supply the outward movement that repeatedly brings the bond under test.
Successive batches make the threefold envoy wording a serial relay.

changed_reading.after: The covenant is a held relation serviced and stress-tested by a continuing dispatch of messengers.
changed_reading.before: A covenant was made, and messengers were subsequently sent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَ ... وَأَرْسَلْنَا links taking a covenant to sending envoys.
baseline_models.mechanism: Taking and binding secure a prior relation, while sending releases a succession of carriers toward its addressees. Each arrival therefore tests an already operative bond rather than opening an unrelated episode.

activation_trace.role: The self's inclination supplies the preference gate applied to incoming content.
The inward faculty of mind and awareness locates the gate within the receivers.
Distinguishing between two supplies the sorting operation marked by the repeated object.
Attributing a person or claim to falsehood supplies reputational elimination.
Taking life supplies bodily elimination as the second output.

changed_reading.after: The receiving selves classify successive unwelcome bearers into reputational or bodily erasure; the two parties are the treated objects, not two innocent descriptions of the audience.
changed_reading.before: The audience dislikes the preaching, then some deny and some kill.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِمَا لَا تَهْوَى أَنفُسُهُمْ فَرِيقًا كَذَّبُوا وَفَرِيقًا يَقْتُلُونَ makes inner inclination precede two object fates.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mismatch between carried content and inward inclination turns the receiving side into a sorter of the arriving envoy stream. The repeated fronted فَرِيقًا partitions bearers into two treated classes: denial attacks credibility, while killing attacks the living carrier.

activation_trace.role: All-encompassing iteration gives each arrival membership in a recurring pattern.
Falsehood supplies the completed response whose perfect form accumulates as record.
Lethal action supplies the response whose imperfect form remains ongoing or recurrent.

changed_reading.after: Denial is tallied as past practice, but killing is voiced as a still-repeatable habit within every-arrival time.
changed_reading.before: Both denial and killing are closed events in a past report.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كُلَّمَا frames repetition, while كَذَّبُوا is perfect and يَقْتُلُونَ is imperfect.
baseline_models.mechanism: Every arrival is a repeatable occasion. Completed denial reads as an accumulated record, while imperfect killing remains durative or habitual, so the verse looks backward yet leaves lethal response grammatically open.

activation_trace.role: Taking hold supplies the covenantal act against which the earlier acts are contrasted.
Making or acquiring covers both prohibited alliance-taking and taking religion as mockery, exposing rival ways of constituting relations.
Making prayer into mockery repeats the instrumental appropriation immediately before the covenant wording.

changed_reading.after: God's taking establishes the binding relation that should govern later takings, while the surrounding takings show sacred relations being remade for convenience.
changed_reading.before: God simply obtained a promise from the addressees.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the focus, the same taking-root governs making allies and making religion or prayer into mockery and play. Against those appropriative takings, taking the covenant becomes an ordered relation that regulates what may be made one's own.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one root across covenant, affiliation, and instrumentalized worship; I infer a contrast between binding relation and self-serving appropriation. A live alternative is that the repetitions only coordinate nearby admonitions.
structural_cues: 5:57 nests لَا تَتَّخِذُوا around actors who اتَّخَذُوا دِينَكُمْ as mockery and play.
5:58 repeats the conversion of prayer into mockery and play.

activation_trace.role: Coming with and bringing joins the messenger's arrival to carried content.
The visitors' coming reverses who approaches whom and makes the encounter a mirrored threshold.
Entering an interior supplies the inbound crossing while disbelief remains the visitors' cargo.
Passing outward completes a crossing that leaves the concealed interior unchanged.
Hiding and covering distinguish performed belief from the inward state exposed by the crossing.

changed_reading.after: Coming is a diagnostic boundary event: the incoming message meets and reveals the receiver's own concealed cargo.
changed_reading.before: Coming only describes the messenger's physical approach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sends a bearer who comes carrying content; 5:61 reverses the direction as suspect speakers come to the believing community, enter and exit with disbelief, and conceal it. Arrival becomes a threshold that diagnoses what the receiver carries inwardly as well as what the messenger carries in.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored comings, carried states, and an inside-outside sequence; I infer that arrival functions diagnostically. Alternatively, 5:61 may describe a separate social encounter without defining messenger reception.
structural_cues: 5:61 places a spoken claim of belief between coming and the paired entry-exit movements.
The directional movements are public, while the final object is what they conceal.

activation_trace.role: Inner inclination supplies the initial pressure that requires social restraint.
The two distinguished outputs expose what the failed restraint system ultimately permits.
Killing marks the endpoint of escalation when no brake stops action.
Restraint and desistance supply the missing institutional brake on harmful speech and consumption.
Reciprocal failure to restrain supplies the network-level absence of correction.

changed_reading.after: The reactions are socially produced endpoints: appetite goes unchecked by leaders and peers until an unwelcome bearer can be discredited or removed.
changed_reading.before: Denial and killing are isolated reactions by individual receivers.

context_deltas.mechanism: Private aversion scales into denial and killing when no feedback channel interrupts it. 5:63 assigns braking responsibility to learned leaders, and 5:79 describes reciprocal failure among participants; the two fates imposed on messengers become terminal outputs of an unregulated social system.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acceleration, two failed restraint sites, and the focus's escalating outputs; I infer a causal path from absent correction to violence. The live alternative is a catalogue of distinct communal offenses rather than one feedback mechanism.
structural_cues: 5:62 says many hasten into sin and aggression; 5:63 asks why authorities do not restrain their speech and consumption.
5:79 uses reciprocal يَتَنَاهَوْنَ after 5:78 names disobedience and repeated transgression.

activation_trace.role: Encompassing each occurrence supplies the repeated arrival frame.
Successive dispatched groups supply fresh inputs to the recurring cycle.
Killing is the focus's embodied conflict output.
The matching every-time construction makes war ignition a structural analogue of messenger arrival.
Igniting fire supplies the conversion from opposition into active conflict.
War and hostility identify the social domain of the ignition.
The flame's subsiding supplies an external interruption that the receivers do not provide themselves.

changed_reading.after: Each arrival re-enters a standing ignition circuit: communication is converted into denial or lethal conflict, while restraint must come from outside that response loop.
changed_reading.before: Each messenger independently meets an adverse response.

context_deltas.mechanism: 5:64 repeats كُلَّمَا for kindling war and divine extinguishing. Beside 5:70's every-arrival sequence, the messenger encounter becomes one phase of an ignition cycle in which unwelcome communication is repeatedly converted into conflict and then checked.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two repeated sequences and their violent terms; I infer that message rejection feeds the same conflict circuit. They may instead be parallel recurrence patterns without a direct causal arrow.
structural_cues: 5:64 and 5:70 share the marked كُلَّمَا recurrence frame.
The earlier cycle explicitly alternates human ignition with divine extinguishing; the focus alternates messenger arrival with human rejection.

activation_trace.role: Firmness and structural integrity supply the covenant's load-bearing function.
Messenger and carried message supply the human relay within the structure.
Standing upright gives إقامة a constructive role: transmitted material must be erected and maintained.
Bringing down and delivering supplies the vertical input to the relay.
Conveying the message to its endpoint defines the carrier's non-optional function.
Protective holding preserves the carrier long enough for delivery to reach its endpoint.

changed_reading.after: The covenant is the support structure for a protected transmission relay; rejection breaks the community's own means of standing up what reaches it.
changed_reading.before: The covenant and the messengers are separate items in a historical list.

context_deltas.mechanism: 5:66-68 arrange revelation as a structure that descends, must be stood up, is conveyed through a protected carrier, and gives the community something to stand on. This turns the focus's covenant-plus-messengers into a maintained delivery infrastructure rather than two historical favors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, establishment, conveyance, protection, and standing; I join them as one delivery-and-support system. A live alternative is that these are adjacent duties and promises rather than a single mechanism.
structural_cues: 5:66 conditions nourishment from above and below on establishing the transmitted books.
5:67 makes delivery exhaustive and pairs it with protection of the messenger.
5:68 says the addressees have no standing until they establish what was sent down to them.

activation_trace.role: Inner inclination supplies the preference that motivates closing against dissonant content.
The inward mind supplies the site whose preferences govern reception.
Supposition supplies the mistaken expectation that no disruptive test will follow.
Assaying metal or a person makes messenger encounter a test of what the covenant community contains.
Blindness of heart and insight supplies repeated visual closure to corrective evidence.
Loss of hearing and refusal to listen supply repeated auditory closure to the messenger's content.

changed_reading.after: Before overt reprisal, the self can protect its preference by disabling recognition itself; even restored reception can relapse when the next test arrives.
changed_reading.before: The self consciously dislikes a message and chooses one of two overt reprisals.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, assuming that no assay will occur leads into blindness and deafness, restoration, and repeated blindness and deafness. The appetite gate is sharpened into sensory auto-closure: expectation of immunity from testing disables the channels by which a messenger could challenge the self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expectation, assay, sensory closure, restoration, and relapse; I infer an auto-protective reception loop. Blindness and deafness may alternatively name consequences rather than chosen defenses.
structural_cues: The فَ sequence moves from expecting no test directly into blindness and deafness.
ثُمَّ marks restoration and then a second sensory shutdown, echoing the focus's every-time pattern.

activation_trace.role: The self's inclination supplies the focus's immediate rejection criterion.
The inward faculty is the local carrier through which the wider social pattern is enacted.
Plural inclinations turn the focus's private preference into transmissible group material.
Following behind supplies the copying relation by which one generation's desires guide another.
Deviation from guidance supplies the repeated state, transmission to many, and renewed outcome.
An extended traveled road makes social desire function as a route rather than a momentary impulse.

changed_reading.after: The preference has a social genealogy: inherited desires pre-shape what feels welcome, so each new rejection can continue and widen an older path.
changed_reading.before: Each receiver independently compares a messenger's words with personal preference.

context_deltas.mechanism: 5:77 repeats desire but makes it followable: a prior people's inclinations become a track that later people trail, reproduce, and extend by leading many away. The focus's preference filter is therefore socially inherited, not merely private psychology.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies desire, following, repeated deviation, and road; I infer a path-dependent transmission mechanism. A live alternative is ordinary moral imitation without a specific reception loop.
structural_cues: 5:77 orders following before three linked forms of going astray: prior deviation, causing many to deviate, and deviation from the even road.
The plural أَهْوَاءَ قَوْمٍ gives the desire a group source and a history.

activation_trace.role: Sending supplies the inbound dispatch directed toward the covenant community.
Coming with content supplies what reaches the self from outside.
The inward faculty first appears as the evaluator of inbound content.
The persons themselves become the source of the outbound action, reversing their earlier receptive position.
Advancing forward supplies the opposite-direction dispatch whose result awaits the self.

changed_reading.after: The self is a two-way gate: it rejects what is sent in and thereby advances its own freight toward the future.
changed_reading.before: The self is a passive appetite that blocks unwanted arrivals.

context_deltas.mechanism: In the focus, messengers are sent toward the receivers and come carrying what their selves reject; in 5:80, those same selves are grammatical agents of what they have advanced for themselves. The self is not only an inbound taste filter but an outbound dispatcher that sends its chosen future ahead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite directions and repeats the self; I infer a transport symmetry in which reception choices become outbound consequences. Alternatively, قَدَّمَتْ may simply denote accumulated deeds without echoing messenger dispatch.
structural_cues: 5:70 directs sending and coming toward them, with their selves as evaluators.
5:80 makes their selves the subject of what is sent or advanced ahead for them.

activation_trace.role: Inclination supplies the negative reception gate that the later circuit reorients rather than erases.
The focus's partition into destructive outcomes provides the group-forming problem answered by inscription and entry.
Hearing as understanding and compliance opens the channel closed in the negative circuit.
Easy abundant flow makes the body release tears instead of acting against the bearer.
Recognition by trace or sign supplies the discriminating act that replaces appetite-only sorting.
Entering a name in a register or company supplies constructive group formation with the witnesses.
What has come from truth directly mirrors the focus's arriving content but receives welcome.
Heartfelt hope redirects desire toward belonging rather than rejection.
Entry into an interior supplies the desired receptive destination.
A human community supplies the positive collective into which the hearers seek incorporation.

changed_reading.after: The focus maps one reception circuit, not an immutable identity: the same arrival can be understood, recognized, embodied as tears, confessed, and used to form a new affiliation.
changed_reading.before: The focus sounds like a fixed identity verdict in which incoming truth necessarily meets appetite and violence.

context_deltas.mechanism: 5:83-84 supplies the opposite reception circuit: hearing becomes understanding, recognition releases bodily overflow, speech confesses, and the hearers request inscription with witnesses while hoping to enter a sound community. Desire is not removed; hope redirects it from vetoing incoming truth toward incorporation by it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered positive sequence; I read it as a causal countercircuit to 5:70. Tears, confession, inscription, and entry could alternatively be parallel signs rather than successive stages.
structural_cues: 5:83 chains hearing, bodily overflow, recognition, confession, and a request to be written with witnesses.
5:84 turns what came from truth into hope for entry among the sound community.
5:86 returns denial as the alternative reception branch.

remaining_uncertainties: The causal link between messenger rejection and 5:64's war ignition is abductive; the two كُلَّمَا sequences may only be structural parallels.
The perfect-imperfect contrast between كَذَّبُوا and يَقْتُلُونَ may mark open habitual violence, but vivid historical narration remains possible.
The overattachment outlier must remain a qualified carrier-content analogy and not be inserted as an unspoken third outcome in 5:70.
strongest_changes: The repeated كُلَّمَا at 5:64 turns every messenger arrival into part of a wider ignition-and-interruption cycle rather than an isolated rejection.
5:63 and 5:79 relocate denial and killing inside a failed social restraint network, while 5:77 shows the appetite filter traveling as an inherited path.
5:80 reverses direction: selves that reject what is sent toward them also advance their own freight ahead.
5:83-84 supplies a full countercircuit in which arrival becomes understanding, recognition, bodily release, confession, inscription, and entry.
summary.what_was_special: Focus-only syntax first made the arriving messengers, not two audience factions, the repeated فَرِيقًا objects. Context then exposed several mechanisms around that sorter: rival ways of taking, delivery infrastructure, sensory closure, absent social brakes, inherited desire, directional reversal, and a constructive reception path.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message supply the carrier-content distinction on which the outlier depends.
Taking the carrier's life supplies the focus's direct bodily distortion of reception.
Speech as belief or doctrine carries both the identity claim and the messenger's corrective claim.
Association with God supplies the contextual form of overattachment that collapses bearer into referent.
The explicit messenger classification restores the carrier role against that collapse.
The passing of earlier generations places this bearer back inside a temporal messenger succession.
Eating food insists on the bearer's embodied creaturely condition.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the context reveals an inverse distortion: a receiver may preserve and magnify the bearer while severing him from the message-bearing role, another way of refusing what came with him.
changed_reading.before: An unwelcome messenger is either discredited or bodily removed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 5:70 explicitly names denial and killing, not elevation of a messenger. It remains anchored in the distinction between رَسُول and what comes بِمَا, and 5:72-75 explicitly juxtaposes association claims with the correction that the Messiah is only a messenger who eats and whose predecessors passed. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory reception analogue, not as a hidden third verb in 5:70.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَسُولٌ بِمَا distinguishes bearer from carried content, while يَقْتُلُونَ shows one response directed at the bearer's body.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Inner inclination splits reception into two destructive outputs.** `ه و ي B004` is self-inclination, `ف ر ق B002` scattering into parts, `ك ذ ب B002` declaring false, and `ق ت ل B001` killing. The repeated “group” divides messengers by response. I infer that desire acts as a sorting mechanism that either nullifies speech or removes its bearer.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Desire acts as a gate that sorts incoming messengers into rejection or death.** Fixed **ه و ي / B004** (“desire and inclination of the self”) governs the repeated arrival of fixed **ر س ل / B005** (“succession in batches”). The covenant supplies an expected reception structure, but each message is tested against inward inclination; 5:71 shows blindness and deafness recurring even after repentance. I infer that the self treats its preference as the admission criterion, converting successive guidance into two kinds of disposal. The ayah reads as an intake-filter mechanism, not merely a record of separate hostile acts.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:71 made the intake-filter visible as blindness and deafness, confirming that desire disposes of messages by disabling the faculties that could receive them.

words.gloss_range: emphatic oath-like prefix that strengthens the completed covenant claim in the opening assertion
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) does not merely decorate the opening; it loads the first clause with sworn emphasis before the history is narrated. It works with the following certainty particle and perfect verb so that the covenant-taking is heard as established testimony, and that strong opening makes the later resistance read as resistance against an already settled act.

topics.headline: emphatic opening turns history into testimony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with assertion and oath pressure before it narrates covenant history.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the prefix as emphatic and part of the assertive opening, while the clause evidence places it over the completed covenant-taking claim.

words.gloss_range: certainty particle before a perfect verb, fixing the covenant-taking as realized and completed
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) tightens the opening assertion by selecting the completed force of the following perfect verb. The reader is not being introduced to an open possibility but to a realized covenant act, which lets the ayah pivot from universal promise into testified history.

topics.headline: certainty fixes the covenant act as completed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the covenant claim is grammatically presented as a realized fact before the response pattern appears.
topics.reason: The particle is locally before the perfect covenant verb, and the opening clause is marked as emphatic testimony.

words.gloss_range: completed divine taking or exacting of the covenant as a direct object, with grasp/seizure pressure kept inside the covenant frame
words.prose: {{ar:أَخَذْنَا}} ({{tr:akhadhnā}}) makes the covenant an act already performed by the divine speaker, not a loose mutual sentiment. The direct object keeps the sense at covenant-taking, while the root's grasp and seizure pressure makes that taking feel binding and exacting. The formula recalls covenant-taking scenes in the same surah (5:12; 5:14) and across the broader pledge register (2:83).
words.root_gloss_range: taking, grasping, seizing, exacting, and sometimes punitive taking; local grammar selects covenant-taking with concrete grasp pressure

topics.headline: completed divine taking with grasp pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the covenant is portrayed as a completed divine taking whose binding force carries a concrete grasping pressure.
topics.reason: The direct object selects covenant-taking, while the root-family evidence supports grasp and seizure pressure without turning the local verb into a punitive act by itself.

words.gloss_range: singular construct covenant or binding pledge taken as the object, concentrating many obligations into one firm bond
words.prose: {{ar:مِيثَٰقَ}} ({{tr:mīthāqa}}) names the object taken: not a vague agreement, but a firm covenant concentrated into one construct bond. Its instrument-like pattern lets the covenant feel like a binding device, while the local grammar keeps it as the direct object of the taking. The word also ties this verse to the surah's covenant scenes (5:12; 5:14) and to the breaking aftermath nearby (5:13).
words.root_gloss_range: trust, firmness, binding, fastening, and fetter imagery; local noun selects covenant as a binding instrument

topics.headline: singular binding covenant as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the covenant is a concentrated binding object, not a loose background theme.
topics.reason: The noun is the accusative object in construct state; lexical evidence supports binding and instrument pressure while local syntax fixes the covenant sense.

words.gloss_range: construct plural lineage term, making the covenant recipient a corporate line dependent on the following proper name
words.prose: {{ar:بَنِىٓ}} ({{tr:banī}}) turns the covenant object toward a corporate lineage. The construct form depends on the following name, so the group is not presented as an abstract population but as the children or descendants identified through that lineage. The building-root pressure remains useful as image: the community is a constructed line, while local grammar selects the kinship term.
words.root_gloss_range: building and offspring/lineage range, with weak-root morphology; local construct noun selects children or descendants while retaining built-lineage pressure

topics.headline: construct lineage makes the recipient corporate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the covenant is routed to a named corporate lineage, with building pressure felt as lineage formation rather than a separate act of building.
topics.reason: The construct chain fixes the local sense as children or descendants of the following name, while root evidence permits background building pressure.

words.gloss_range: foreign proper name completing the construct lineage and anchoring the covenant community
words.prose: {{ar:إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ}} ({{tr:isrāʾīla}}) completes the construct chain and gives the covenant recipient its proper-name anchor. Because QAC treats it as a foreign proper noun, any etymological pressure must remain backgrounded; locally, the payoff is the fixed community label. Variant handling of the hamza-yā sequence keeps the name phonologically active without changing its referent or turning it into a new Arabic root argument.

topics.headline: foreign proper name anchors the lineage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the covenant recipient is anchored by a fixed foreign proper name, not by a new Arabic root argument.
topics.reason: The local grammar makes the name the genitive complement of the lineage term, while the foreign-name tag narrows etymological claims to background value.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining covenant-taking to messenger-sending as parallel divine acts
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the next clause joined to the first rather than starting an unrelated scene. The covenant was taken, and messengers were sent; the connector makes sending the covenant-facing continuation of the opening divine action pair.

topics.headline: connector joins covenant-taking and sending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that messenger-sending is grammatically tied to covenant-taking as the second divine act.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses the conjunction as coordination between the two perfect divine verbs.

words.gloss_range: completed divine dispatch in Form IV, sending messengers toward the named community
words.prose: {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَآ}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}) is the second completed divine act. Form IV makes the movement causative dispatch, while the direction phrase and plural object keep the release imagery aimed at a community and embodied in envoys. It also begins the local root ladder that moves from sending, to messengers, to each arriving messenger.
words.root_gloss_range: sending, dispatching, releasing, and flowing forth; Form IV locally selects causative dispatch with directed movement

topics.headline: Form IV dispatch with directed flow
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sending is a completed divine dispatch aimed at them, not a vague release of messengers into the world.
topics.reason: The Form IV verb takes a direction phrase and direct object, selecting causative dispatch while preserving root movement pressure.

words.gloss_range: directional prepositional phrase with plural suffix, marking the named lineage as the target of dispatch
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ilayhim}}) inserts the target before the sent messengers are named. The suffix carries the named lineage forward, so the sending is not generic; it is directed toward them and keeps the referent chain tight from covenant to dispatch.

topics.headline: direction phrase keeps dispatch aimed at them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the messenger-sending is aimed at the same named community rather than left as a general mission statement.
topics.reason: The preposition and suffix are governed by the sending verb and inherit the prior lineage referent.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative plural messengers as the direct object of sending, an open pool later distributed into repeated singular encounters
words.prose: {{ar:رُسُلًۭا}} ({{tr:rusulan}}) gives the sending its object: messengers in an indefinite plural. That openness lets the verse move from a pool of sent envoys into the repeated encounter of one messenger at a time. The root echo with the sending verb makes the sent ones audibly belong to the dispatch, while their later treatment becomes denial and killing.
words.root_gloss_range: sending, dispatch, envoyhood, and release; local plural noun selects sent envoys who embody the mission

topics.headline: indefinite plural messengers become repeated encounters
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from many sent messengers to the later pattern of each arriving messenger.
topics.reason: The noun is the direct object of sending; its plural indefiniteness supports the later distribution into singular repeated arrivals.

words.gloss_range: totalizing temporal compound introducing a repeated whenever-pattern
words.prose: {{ar:كُلَّمَا}} ({{tr:kullamā}}) is the hinge from completed divine acts to repeated human response. Its totalizing force makes the pattern exhaustive: whenever a messenger arrives, the same resistance frame is triggered, and the doubled lām compresses that exhaustive repetition into the sound of the particle itself. The formula also recalls the messenger-response pattern in 2:87 while this verse reports it in third-person historical form.
words.root_gloss_range: allness, totality, exhaustion, and inclusiveness; local compound selects exhaustive temporal iteration

topics.headline: totalizing whenever-frame governs the response cycle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is not narrating one event but an exhaustive repeated cycle of arrival and response.
topics.reason: The compound introduces the repeated conditional protasis, and the root/compound evidence supports totalizing temporal iteration.

words.gloss_range: perfect arrival reaching them in each repeated condition, with the attached suffix making them the reached recipients
words.prose: {{ar:جَآءَهُمْ}} ({{tr:jāʾahum}}) makes each encounter concrete: a messenger reaches them. The perfect form fits the repeated condition as a completed arrival in each cycle, while the attached suffix keeps the named community as the recipients. The messenger-arrival formula echoes 2:87, and the following content phrase shows what comes with the messenger, so the verb can carry arrival and reaching without needing to absorb the whole message into itself.
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, reaching, and bringing in some constructions; local verb selects arrival toward the attached recipients while the following phrase carries content

topics.headline: arrival reaches the same recipients in each cycle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices each repeated cycle as an actual messenger-arrival reaching the same community.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect with an attached object pronoun in the protasis; the following prepositional content phrase narrows any bringing sense to the local construction.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular messenger as subject of arrival, individuating each envoy within the repeated pattern
words.prose: {{ar:رَسُولٌۢ}} ({{tr:rasūlun}}) narrows the earlier plural messengers into the singular subject of each arrival. The indefiniteness makes the pattern general: whichever messenger comes with unwelcome content enters the same response frame. This is the third local appearance of the sending root, so the ayah telescopes dispatch, sent envoys, and each arriving envoy into one chain, with the 2:87 formula still audible behind the report.
words.root_gloss_range: sending, dispatch, envoyhood, and message-bearing; local noun selects a sent envoy whose identity is mission-bearing

topics.headline: singular messenger individuates the repeated encounter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the plural dispatch becomes a repeated one-by-one encounter with any messenger who arrives.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative subject of arrival and indefinite singular, matching the repeated conditional structure.

words.gloss_range: bound preposition of accompaniment/content, linking the messenger's arrival to what he brings
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) turns arrival into arrival with content. The messenger is not merely present before the community; he comes bearing something, and the following relative clause will define that something by its clash with their inner desire.

topics.headline: preposition carries the message content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conflict is not with mere arrival but with the content carried by the messenger.
topics.reason: The preposition introduces the relative content phrase attached to the messenger's arrival.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun governed by the preceding preposition, opening an unspecified but active content clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) keeps the messenger's content open enough to cover whatever arrives in that repeated pattern, then immediately lets the relative clause define it by non-desire. The openness is therefore not vagueness; it is a broad content slot whose local grammar is controlled by the following negated desire clause.

topics.headline: relative content slot is defined by non-desire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the content is deliberately broad but locally defined by whether their selves desire it.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the word a relative pronoun governed by the preceding preposition and controlling the following clause.

words.gloss_range: negation particle over an imperfect desire verb, marking ongoing non-desire inside the content clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is the pivot inside the relative clause: the message is characterized by what their selves do not desire. Because it negates an imperfect verb, the conflict is not a single moment of dislike but an ongoing or habitual non-alignment between revealed content and inner preference.

topics.headline: negation makes inner non-desire the conflict point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the response pattern begins inside a negated desire clause before it becomes denial and killing.
topics.reason: The particle negates the imperfect desire verb inside the relative clause, making non-desire the local conflict marker.

words.gloss_range: imperfect desire or inclination, negated here and agreeing with the broken-plural subject, with falling-image pressure kept inside desire
words.prose: {{ar:تَهْوَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:tahwā}}) names the inner criterion that rejects the messenger's content: what their selves do not incline toward. The imperfect makes that non-desire feel continuing, and the root's falling image sharpens desire as a downward pull rather than neutral preference. The formula recalls 2:87, where the same desire criterion is tied to messenger rejection.
words.root_gloss_range: desiring, inclining, falling, and dropping downward; local verb selects desire/inclination while preserving downward-pull imagery

topics.headline: desire is negated and felt as downward inclination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the messenger conflict is measured by inner desire, with desire felt as a continuing downward inclination.
topics.reason: The local verb is negated and agrees with the broken-plural subject; lexical evidence supports falling pressure while the clause selects desire/inclination.

words.gloss_range: their selves as broken-plural subject of desire, pluralizing inner agency and binding it to the same referent chain
words.prose: {{ar:أَنفُسُهُمْ}} ({{tr:anfusuhum}}) places the source of rejection inside their own selves. The broken plural subject governs the desire verb and the suffix keeps the community chain intact. The pronoun also shifts 2:87's direct address into third-person historical report. Because the root range includes self, soul, and breath-life, the later killing lands after an inward criterion that already touches life-language.
words.root_gloss_range: self, soul, breath, life, blood, and inner person; local noun selects selves while preserving life-breath pressure

topics.headline: possessed selves become the subject of non-desire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rejection pattern starts with their own selves as the grammatical and moral subject of desire.
topics.reason: The noun is the nominative subject of the desire verb with a possessive suffix, and lexical evidence supports self/life-breath pressure without displacing the local self sense.

words.gloss_range: fronted indefinite singular collective portion, the object of denial and first half of the split response
words.prose: {{ar:فَرِيقًۭا}} ({{tr:farīqan}}) starts the split response by foregrounding one unnamed portion before the denial verb. The root's separation pressure matters locally: the messenger response is divided into portions, and this first portion is defined by being denied. Its fronted accusative shape also prepares the repeated frame that will return before the killing verb.
words.root_gloss_range: separating, dividing, distinguishing, and portioning; local noun selects a separated faction or group

topics.headline: first fronted faction begins the split response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the response is divided into foregrounded portions before the actions of denial and killing are named.
topics.reason: The noun is a fronted accusative object in the first apodosis, and lexical evidence supports portion/separation pressure.

words.gloss_range: Form II perfect collective denial, accusing of falsehood rather than merely lying, completed before the killing clause
words.prose: {{ar:كَذَّبُوا۟}} ({{tr:kadhdhabū}}) names the first response as completed false-deeming. Form II and the written doubling make this stronger than merely saying they lied; they actively accused the messenger-side of falsehood. Its perfect tense also becomes the first pole of the ayah's tense contrast: denial is closed, while the final killing verb remains open and ongoing.
words.root_gloss_range: lying, falsehood, denial, and declaring false; Form II locally selects active false-deeming or accusation of lying

topics.headline: Form II denial is completed before ongoing killing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first outcome is an intensified completed accusation of falsehood, setting up the contrast with ongoing killing.
topics.reason: The verb is Form II perfect in the first response clause and governs the fronted object; lexical and form evidence support false-deeming.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction linking the second response clause to the first and marking escalation within one parallel frame
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) stands at the boundary where verbal denial is joined to physical killing. It keeps the second clause coordinated with the first, so escalation does not break the grammar; it intensifies inside the same response frame.

topics.headline: connector joins denial to killing as escalation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that killing is coordinated with denial as a linked escalation, not attached as a separate afterthought.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the second response clause to the first through coordination while preserving their parallel shape.

words.gloss_range: second fronted indefinite singular collective portion, object of the killing verb and completion of the binary response frame
words.prose: {{ar:فَرِيقًۭا}} ({{tr:farīqan}}) repeats the same fronted object shape, so the grammar makes the two outcomes comparable before the verbs separate them. This second portion is not merely another group; its separation is now attached to killing, and the repeated noun makes the later tense shift stand out sharply.
words.root_gloss_range: separating, dividing, distinguishing, and portioning; local noun selects a separated faction, now attached to lethal action

topics.headline: second fronted faction completes the binary frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same fronted faction-shape repeated, while the second verb escalates the outcome into killing.
topics.reason: The noun repeats the first fronted accusative object frame and is governed by the following killing verb.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect collective killing, governing the fronted object and closing the ayah with ongoing or vivid lethal action
words.prose: {{ar:يَقْتُلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaqtulūna}}) closes the ayah with the response still grammatically open. It governs the fronted faction as the object, while the plural ending keeps the perpetrators collective. The tense shift is the main payoff: denial was perfect and completed, but killing is imperfect and left vivid or ongoing. The accepted intensive variant sharpens the pressure toward repeated or systematic killing without replacing the standard Form I reading, and the 2:87 echo shifts the accusation from direct address to third-person report.
words.root_gloss_range: killing, slaying, removal of life, and termination; local verb selects killing while variant evidence adds intensity as contrast

topics.headline: imperfect killing closes the ayah with unresolved violence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on an imperfect killing verb, so violence remains vivid and unresolved after completed denial.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect and transitive with a fronted object; variant evidence can intensify the pressure as contrast while the standard local form remains Form I.
